description: This file defines the Zend_Uri_Http class, which handles parsing, validation, and construction of HTTP and HTTPS URIs within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for managing URI components such as username, password, host, port, path, query, and fragment, with validation and encoding logic.

classes.name: Zend_Uri_Http
classes.description: A class for handling HTTP and HTTPS URIs, including parsing, validation, and component management.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a Zend_Uri_Http object from a URI string starting with 'http://' or 'https://'.

methods.name: _parseUri
methods.description: Parses the scheme-specific part of the URI into components like username, password, host, port, path, query, and fragment.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full URI string from the current components after validation.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Validates all URI components; returns true if all are valid.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username component or false if not set.

methods.name: validateUsername
methods.description: Validates the username component against allowed characters.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username component after validation.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password component or false if not set.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.description: Validates the password component against allowed characters.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password component after validation.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host component or false if not set.

methods.name: validateHost
methods.description: Validates the host component using Zend_Validate_Hostname.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the host component after validation.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port component or false if not set.

methods.name: validatePort
methods.description: Validates the port as a number between 1 and 65535.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the port component after validation.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path component or '/' if not set.

methods.name: validatePath
methods.description: Validates the path component against URI path rules.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the path component after validation.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the query string or false if not set.

methods.name: getQueryAsArray
methods.description: Returns the query string as an associative array.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates the query string against URI rules.

methods.name: addReplaceQueryParameters
methods.description: Adds or replaces query parameters and returns the old query.

methods.name: removeQueryParameters
methods.description: Removes specified query parameters and returns the old query.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the query string from a string or array after validation.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment or false if not set.

methods.name: validateFragment
methods.description: Validates the fragment against URI rules.

methods.name: setFragment
methods.description: Sets the fragment after validation.
